description: This PHP source file defines a class ManageReviewMenuConfigurator that implements the MenuConfigurator interface. It configures menu behavior related to performance review management within the OrangeHRM system, specifically overriding a screen for search performance reviews.

classes.name: ManageReviewMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring the menu related to performance reviews in OrangeHRM. Implements menu configuration by overriding the performance review search screen.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default screen for performance review searches with 'searchPerformanceReview'.
